shortDescription: Terra Balcanica Resources OTC:TEBAF has entered into an agreement to acquire the remaining 10% equity interest in its Bosnian subsidiary, Drina resources doo Srebrenica, giving the company 100% ownership of the Viogor polymetallic exploration project in eastern Bosnia and Herzegovina.To buyout the…

children: the remaining 10% equity interest in its Bosnian subsidiary, Drina resources doo Srebrenica, giving the company 100% ownership of the Viogor polymetallic exploration project in eastern Bosnia and Herzegovina.
To buyout the remaining minority stake from two arm's-length vendors, Terra Balcanica will issue an aggregate of 6.33M common shares.
The consideration shares will be subject to a four-month-and-one-day statutory hold period and remain subject to approval from the Canadian Securities Exchange.

The development follows the May 2026 issuance of a new mineral exploration license for lead, zinc, copper, and related metals by the Republic of Srpska Ministry of Energy and Mines. The permit carries an initial three-year term, with potential extensions for up to seven years of total tenure.

Terra Balcanica has also extended the closing date of its non-brokered private placement to on or before October 8, 2026. Initially announced in late June 2026, the offering aims to raise gross proceeds of up to C$750K through the issuance of up to 15M units at C$0.05 per unit.
Each unit consists of one common share and one common share purchase warrant, exercisable at C$0.10 for 24 months post-closing.
Net proceeds will be used to execute a ground geophysical survey at the Cumavici target, launch the Phase IV drilling program at Cumavici, and support general working capital.

title: Terra Balcanica secures 100% control of Viogor project and extends C$750K private placement
